arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: model_type
arg.description: yolox for the YOLOX models (onnx), nanodet for NanoDet-Plus (onnx, input 416x416), yolov8 for the models of the output of YOLOv8, YOLOv9 and YOLO11 (onnx, OpenCV 4.9 or later), or detection_model for the models of cv::dnn::DetectionModel, e.g. YOLO (darknet), SSD (caffe, tensorflow), with config, input_width, input_height, scale and swap_rb

arg.name: model
arg.description: Path or URL of the model (e.g. .onnx, .weights), empty for YOLOX-S (yolox) or NanoDet-Plus (nanodet) trained on COCO of opencv_zoo

arg.name: config
arg.description: Path or URL of the network configuration (e.g. .cfg) of the model, or empty

arg.name: classes
arg.description: Path or URL of the class names, one name per line, or empty for the classes of COCO for yolox, nanodet and yolov8

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: use_cuda
arg.description: Run the node in the docker image of OpenCV with CUDA (cuda_image, built from docker/ of opencv_apps), by scripts/run_in_docker

arg.name: cuda_image
arg.description: The docker image of use_cuda, pulled at the first use: ghcr.io/ros-perception/opencv_apps:cuda (OpenCV 4.12, docker/cuda) or ghcr.io/ros-perception/opencv_apps:opencv5-cuda (OpenCV 5.1, docker/opencv5-cuda), or an image built from them

arg.name: input_width
arg.description: Width of the network input, a multiple of 32 for yolox and yolov8, 416 for nanodet

arg.name: input_height
arg.description: Height of the network input, a multiple of 32 for yolox and yolov8, 416 for nanodet

arg.name: scale
arg.description: Multiplier of the pixel values for the network input, for detection_model

arg.name: swap_rb
arg.description: Swap the red and blue channels, true for the models trained in RGB, for detection_model

arg.name: confidence_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the confidence to detect the objects

arg.name: nms_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the overlap of the objects to suppress, by non maximum suppression

arg.name: detection_3d
arg.description: Run detection_3d, which publishes the 3D boxes and the TF frames of the objects, from depth, or from the depth estimated from image by dnn_depth_estimation when depth is empty

arg.name: depth
arg.description: With detection_3d: the full name of the depth image registered to image, e.g. /camera/camera/aligned_depth_to_color/image_raw of realsense2_camera, or empty to estimate the depth of image by dnn_depth_estimation (Depth Anything V2 Metric, indoors)

arg.name: camera_info
arg.description: With detection_3d: the camera info of image, camera_info next to image by default (e.g. /camera/rgb/camera_info of /camera/rgb/image_raw)

arg.name: rviz
arg.description: With detection_3d: show the image of the detector, the depth image and the 3D boxes (markers of detection_3d) in rviz2 (rviz/detection_3d.rviz)

arg.name: rviz_points
arg.description: With rviz: the point cloud shown in rviz2, e.g. /camera/camera/depth/color/points of realsense2_camera, or empty

arg.name: fixed_frame
arg.description: With rviz: the fixed frame of rviz2, e.g. camera_link of the camera
